integrity: Proof and exact rational checker supplied; no unproved claims of entropy production, empirical validation or general independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Independent Poisson kicks and proportional resets, stationarity, positive iid jump marks with finite third moment. A vanishing third-order statistic is not equivalent to reversibility; the general polynomial affine-reset cross-moment theorem supplies much of the underlying calculation and is a serious novelty/priority qualification. Independent specialist audit not performed.
title: A third-jump-moment threshold and covariance twins with opposite time arrows in reset transport
